anomalies.title: Ingredients goodwill impairment
anomalies.explanation: The Company recognized a 41.061 million dollar noncash goodwill impairment in fiscal 2026, reducing goodwill and operating earnings; it is separately classified as an operating asset loss.
anomalies.basis: Note 1 goodwill and consolidated statements of income

anomalies.title: Large seasonal cash reduction and working-capital release
anomalies.explanation: Cash and cash equivalents declined by 197.937 million dollars while operating cash flow was 129.100 million dollars; the cash decline was driven mainly by 284.343 million dollars of financing cash outflow and 42.956 million dollars of investing cash outflow, partly offset by operating cash generation.
anomalies.basis: Consolidated balance sheets and statements of cash flows

anomalies.title: Income tax allocation limitation
anomalies.explanation: The filing discloses 1.818 million dollars of tax on equity-method earnings but does not split the remaining consolidated tax among operating, other non-operating, and financing sources. The review uses that disclosed component and allocates the remaining 44.839 million dollars at a common residual effective rate; the three economic tax lines are therefore partly estimated and reconcile to total income tax expense of 46.657 million dollars.
anomalies.basis: Consolidated statements of income and Note 1 equity-method tax reconciliation

anomalies.title: Other operating balance movement not fully decomposed
anomalies.explanation: Other operating net assets increased by 23.584 million dollars. The filing provides component balances but no complete rollforward for tax, pension, other current and noncurrent assets, and other long-term liabilities; the amount remains a program-calculated unexplained movement and is not characterized as a transfer.
anomalies.basis: Consolidated balance sheets and Notes 5, 9, 12 and 17

anomalies.title: Unconsolidated investment balance movement not fully decomposed
anomalies.explanation: Investments in unconsolidated affiliates increased by 2.970 million dollars. Disclosed equity-method net income of 1.612 million dollars and dividends received of 1.857 million dollars explain a net reduction of 0.245 million dollars; the remaining 3.215 million dollar increase is not separately attributed in the filing and remains unexplained.
anomalies.basis: Consolidated balance sheets and Note 1 equity-method reconciliation
